item.title: Bahrain's civil defence evacuates multi-storey building due to fire
item.description:
Bahrain's civil defence evacuates multi-storey building due to fire

Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior said that civil defence teams evacuated a multi-storey building in the Gulf country's north west due to a fire. 

"Civil Defence evacuated a multi-story building in Souq Waqif as a precaution, and extinguished a fire in the building. No injuries were reported," the ministry said in a statement. 

"The National Ambulance took the necessary measures at the site, and investigations are underway to determine the cause of the fire," it added.

item.title: Iran's army launches drone attack at Kuwait base used by US military
item.description:
Iran's army launches drone attack at Kuwait base used by US military

Iran’s army has said it fired a drone targeting the Ali al-Salem Airbase in Kuwait, according to Iranian state media IRNA.

"This morning, the Islamic Republic of Iran's army's destructive combat drones targeted Patriot defense systems and drone and missile launchers of the US terrorist army at the Ali al-Salem base in Kuwait with destructive drones," the statement read.

"In defense of Iran, we will not bow to any power, but our response to any threat or aggression will be decisive, crushing, and without geographical limitations," the army added

Earlier, the Kuwaiti ⁠⁠military said ⁠⁠that its air defences were ⁠⁠countering hostile drone ⁠⁠attacks.

item.title: Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran
item.description:
Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cast doubt about reports of an "imminent threat" from Iran on Washington.

Speaking to reporters in the Philippines, Rubio said that US authorities routinely check for  potential threats against the country, but added that most intelligence leads are not considered credible. 

When asked if he was concerned about a possible attack on Washington, he said: "I am not. But again, we're concerned every day about anything that threatens our country ... I don't think there's any imminent threat."

"The United States is always on the lookout for anyone who tries to do harm to our country and to our people. And we have threat streams every day, and the majority of them are not credible. We have to follow up on them," Rubio added.

Rubio also questioned the credibility of sources cited in a CNN report about an alleged Iranian plot targeting the US capital, saying: "Some of your intelligence sources are liars; others are liars and criminals."

"I won't even comment on it because I don't know who's leaking this stuff to you guys. But they're either showboats and liars, or probably criminals if they're saying anything that's even half true."

item.title: Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank
item.description:
Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank

Israeli settlers shot dead an elderly Palestinian woman and wounded eight of her family members during an attack outside her home in the village of Ein al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho in the occupied West Bank. 

According to eyewitnesses, armed settlers shot 73-year-old Fidda Fheidat in the head, killing her on the spot. 

The settlers, who had recently seized eight Palestinian homes in an area adjacent to the village, went on to fire at other members of the family, wounding eight of them. 

According to Jihad Mahalis, a member of the village’s local committee, the settlers have launched attacks on the village homes every single night since seizing the properties, which are located some 500 metres away from the rest of the village’s homes.

item.title: Somali president accuses UAE of internal interference
item.description: Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud accused the United Arab Emirates of serious interference in Somalia’s internal affairs, Anadolu reports. Mohamud said Abu Dhabi has gone so far as to establish military bases in parts of the Horn of Africa. He said it established forces outside Mogadishu’s national security framework, without the approval of the federal government. “I did not come in front of you to talk to you about easy issues,” Mohamud told the nation in a televised speech, before addressing the historic relations between the two countries and describing the UAE interference as “blatant” against the country’s sovereignty. item.title: Hind Rajab Foundation urges US to prosecute former Israeli defense minister for Gaza, Lebanon crimes
item.description: The Hind Rajab Foundation (HRF) filed a request Tuesday with the US Justice Department seeking the prosecution of former Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant for alleged war crimes in the Gaza Strip and Lebanon, and genocide in the Palestinian enclave, Anadolu reports. The foundation said in a statement that the request concerns crimes allegedly authorized or ordered by Gallant during his tenure between October 2023 and November 2024. The move comes ahead of Gallant’s planned visit Wednesday to New York City, where he is expected to deliver a keynote address at the annual summit of the MirYam Institute, a pro-Israel nonprofit organization.
